name: rescue
steps: log (the cushioning stick steps once per game frame with a gain per game second: at 16 ms wall time it ran ~8 times a headless frame) the tank runs dry in a low hover (10 ft over the flat apron round the home shaft, inside the safe part of the H-V diagram): the engine quits, cushion the landing with the collective

eval (()=>{ const H=__G.H, x=__G.HOME_B.x+13.5, z=__G.HOME_B.z, gy=__G.terrainH(x, z); H.reset(new __G.THREE.Vector3(x, gy + 1.84 + 3, z), 0, false, 1); __G.G.fuel = 0.3; window.__c = 0.38; window.__lt = __G.war.time; window.__ap = setInterval(()=>{ const H=__G.H, dt = __G.war.time - window.__lt; if (H.landed) { __G.HI.setCollective(0); return; } if (dt <= 0) return; window.__lt = __G.war.time; window.__c = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, window.__c + (-H.vel.y - Math.max(0.4, H.agl * 0.5)) * 1.8 * dt)); __G.HI.setCollective(window.__c); }, 16); return gy; })()

eval (clearInterval(__ap), {landed:__G.H.landed, alive:__G.Z.alive, run:__G.H.run, rpm:+__G.H.rpm.toFixed(2), fuel:__G.G.fuel, rescue:!!__G.G.rescue, lives:__G.G.lives, hint:document.getElementById('hint').textContent})
